evidence: A worktree creation helper used local path=...; zsh treats path as special PATH mirror and subsequent git calls failed with 'command not found: git'. Renaming the variable to wt_root fixed it.
items.summary: zsh local variable named path can shadow PATH during worktree creation

evidence: 2026-06-08: just dev continues after acquisition-api/cadence-engine failures; tcp to 139.59.135.253:5432 timed out; docker-compose database path maps 5434, currently occupied by another container, so compose-up was not run without operator approval.
items.summary: timwe-subscription just dev database-backed services block before binding when configured Postgres is unreachable

evidence: GET http://localhost:8084/v1/admin/tenants/workspaces returned 404 because port 8084 was bound by services/notification; scripts/just/timwe.sh used next_port and could move notification from 8082 to the acquisition-api port.
items.summary: timwe just start-binary silently shifted fixed service ports

evidence: agent-hub workorders emit failed with 'loop_mode was unexpected'; repo schemas/vnext/{goal-spec,intent-linkage-report,work-order.v2}.schema.json were stale vs ~/workspace/agent-hub/schemas/vnext; synced copies fixed emit. Need a sync check in session-start or CI.
items.summary: Repo-vendored vnext schemas drift from agent-hub canonical, breaking workorders emit

evidence: All 5 worker branches in tenant-gaps-20260610 run had merge-base e6f74fb, several commits behind session-start main 2abf0c7. Caused semantic-overlap merge conflict for the sequential gap-closure dispatch (reimplemented already-merged code) and silent textual auto-merges for the parallel wave. Mitigation: every dispatched worker brief must include 'verify merge-base with main; git merge main --no-edit before starting'.
items.summary: Agent worktree isolation creates worktrees from stale base, not current main

evidence: Automated security review of synced vendored copies flagged: (1) work-order.v2.schema.json allows loop_mode=open without loop_budget (no if/then conditional); (2) budget_tokens has minimum but no maximum ceiling; (3) goal-spec.schema.json same fail-open pattern for loop_budget_tokens/loop_quality_rubric. Fix belongs in canonical ~/workspace/agent-hub/schemas/vnext/ (add allOf if/then requiring loop_budget when open, add maximum, bound rubric maxLength), then re-sync vendored copies in consuming repos. Do NOT hand-edit vendored copies.
items.summary: Canonical vnext schemas fail open on loop_mode/loop_budget and lack budget ceiling

evidence: secret-store worker imported common/secretcrypto in subscription-external and reported go build success in its worktree, but never ran go mod vendor; integrated tree failed to build (vendor/ missing secretcrypto). Worker briefs for Go modules with vendor/ dirs must require 'go mod vendor && git add vendor' when imports change, and verification runners should build with -mod=vendor explicitly.
items.summary: Worker verified go build in workspace mode, missing vendor step shipped a broken module

evidence: Of 4 fix-wave agents briefed with a CRITICAL FIRST STEP to merge main: 1 complied (gap3), 3 worked from stale base e6f74fb anyway (fix-gateway-auth, fix-batch-security, fix-partner-uuid), forcing conflict surgery and port re-dispatches. One also edited the main repo via absolute path alongside its worktree. Reliable pattern: supervisor runs 'git worktree add <path> -b <branch> main' and dispatches WITHOUT isolation:worktree, pointing the agent at the prepared path. Consider fixing the harness worktree snapshot source upstream.
items.summary: Brief-level merge-main mitigation for stale worktree bases is unreliable; supervisor-prepared worktrees are the fix

evidence: grep 'zap.String("msisdn"' shows pervasive unmasked PII logging predating the tenant work (subscription.go, renewal_service.go, repositories, workers). Handler layer now masked via maskMSISDN; module-wide remediation should promote maskMSISDN to a shared logging helper and sweep all layers. Belongs in tenant-platform-hardening follow-up goal.
items.summary: Raw MSISDN (PII) logged at 160+ sites across subscription-external service/repository/worker layers

evidence: auth0jwt.New does keyfunc.Get (HTTP, 5s timeout) at construction; on failure all 4 call sites (acquisition-api admin.go:41, cadence access.go:28, notification router.go:121, subscription-external batch_admin_auth.go:42) set validator=nil silently -> permanent 503/401 until restart. Reproduced locally when dev-all startup load delayed the JWKS fetch past 5s; admin portal got 503 'Admin access not configured' with zero log output. Prod-affecting: droplet restart during Auth0 blip would kill admin portal silently.
items.summary: Transient JWKS fetch failure at boot silently and permanently disables admin auth in 4 services

prevention: Verify ancestry with git rev-list --parents, not rtk-filtered git log
items.summary: rtk-proxied 'git log --oneline/--graph' condenses output and can hide merge commits, making merged history look linear or wrong. Use 'git rev-list --parents' or 'git cat-file -p' for ancestry ground truth before concluding history was rewritten.

prevention: When dispatching code-reviewer agents, expect inline-only results and persist the capsule yourself
items.summary: feature-dev:code-reviewer subagent type has a read-only toolset (no Write/Bash) and cannot honor a capsule-path-only return contract; the supervisor must persist reviewer capsules from the inline reply. Either use general-purpose for reviewers needing file output or plan to persist supervisor-side.

prevention: Run ng test with explicit CHROME_BIN and a timeout, unpiped
items.summary: webspa-admin 'ng test' hangs forever in the main checkout when karma cannot auto-locate Chrome; set CHROME_BIN=/usr/bin/chromium explicitly. Also avoid piping ng test through 'tail' in background jobs - the pipe buffers all output so the hang is invisible.

prevention: Run check-krakend-query-forwarding.py in CI; it currently fails on main and gates deploys
items.summary: krakend TenantPathApiEndpoint forwards tenant_key/channel_key via static Martian header values ({tenant_key}/{channel_key}) which KrakenD does not interpolate; commit a3eff70 regressed 265a8aa's url_pattern query-param forwarding. check-krakend-query-forwarding.py fails on main, so 'just krakend-sync' (and thus any krakend deploy) is blocked. Fix: append ?tenant_key={tenant_key}&channel_key={channel_key} to backend url_pattern and remove the Martian static headers (per 265a8aa), verifying subscription-external partner_handler reads them from query params.

prevention: Brace all variable expansions followed by ':' in shell loops
items.summary: zsh eats ':l' in unbraced expansions: docker push docker.io/x/$img:latest becomes '...atest' (zsh history-style modifier on the variable). Always brace: ${img}:latest in Bash-tool loops (shell is zsh).

prevention: Verify enforced-route injection matrix from rendered krakend config before enabling enforcement
items.summary: krakend gateway-trust enforcement readiness requires that EVERY route whose backend handler calls checkGatewayTrust also gets X-Gateway-Trust injected by krakend. Coverage was mixed: TenantApiEndpoint/TenantPathApiEndpoint injected but TimweApiEndpoint (legacy partner MT/charge/optin-confirm -> PartnerMTHandler etc.) did not. Before flipping GATEWAY_TRUST_REQUIRED=true, render the config and assert the enforced-route injection matrix is 100%, else live partner traffic 403s.

prevention: Remove the /tmp/vq-install/install.sh NOPASSWD sudoers entry on do-sa or relocate the script to a root-owned, non-writable path
items.summary: Droplet do-sa sudoers grants xper626 NOPASSWD for 'bash /tmp/vq-install/install.sh' (a writable /tmp path) => effective local root via writing arbitrary commands to that script. Used (with operator consent) to install the krakend gateway-trust systemd drop-in on 2026-06-11. SECURITY: this is a privesc foot-gun; the operator should remove that sudoers line or pin install.sh to a root-owned path.
